name: Sit-to-Stand
steps: Sit near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet hip-width apart and your arms crossed over your chest.
Lean forward from your hips until your weight shifts onto your feet.
Press through both feet and straighten your hips and knees to stand tall.
Reach your hips back and bend your knees to sit down gently.
tips: Keep your heels on the floor as you rise.
Control the last part of the descent rather than dropping onto the seat.
